clips.text: What if you woke up tomorrow and you could feel Earth's magnetic field? Not see it. Feel it — like knowing which way is up.
North would be a tug behind your left ear. South, a pull the other way. No compass app. No signal. Just a direction, built in.
Your brain already answers the field — 34 people in a dark room proved it in 2019. Their brainwaves dropped when the field turned. Nobody felt a thing.
Birds see it. Turtles map it. Dogs line up north-south to do their business. You might be carrying the same sense — switched off.
So here's the test: if you woke up tomorrow with a built-in compass, what's the first place you'd go — without GPS?
Right now, an invisible force is passing straight through your body — and your brain may already be listening.
